# PC VR

Every app in this list that runs on PC VR. That is 6 apps with 2 for Plex and 4 for Jellyfin and 1 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [JellyVR](https://github.com/VersaYT/JellyVR) - Godot-based VR client. `Jellyfin` · `Quest` `PC VR` · `Apache-2.0`
- [JellyXR](https://github.com/Cuteminded/JellyXR) - VR media client for Quest and Steam Frame. `Jellyfin` · `Quest` `PC VR` · `Apache-2.0` `Free`
- [PlexBuster](https://github.com/filip-strelec/PlexBuster) - VR browser for navigating a Plex library. `Plex` · `PC VR` · `Open source`
- [Reel Room](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4762320) - Paid PC VR theatre on Steam, also usable via Quest Link. `Jellyfin` · `PC VR` · `Paid`
- [resonite-plex](https://github.com/ikanibee/resonite-plex) - Plex media player for the Resonite VR world. `Plex` · `PC VR` · `CC0-1.0` `Stale 2024`
- [Whirligig](https://www.reddit.com/r/OculusQuest/comments/1v98kld/whirligig_major_update_goes_live_media_server/) - Paid Meta Quest video player. `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `Quest` `PC VR` · `Paid`
